# Reporting problems and suggesting changes

Bug reports, questions, and suggestions are welcome. Use the bug-report form for reproducible problems; a regular issue is fine for questions and feature requests.

Include the module, Foundry, and game-system versions. Explain what you expected, what happened, and how to reproduce it. For visual problems, a screenshot helps. Remove private information before sharing it.

Keep discussion focused on the module. Criticism and disagreement are welcome; personal attacks, threats, and spam are not.
